tag: An intelligence layer built around your biology.
body: Ask anything about your own data. Jade brings together your Ring, Blood Vision, Glucose and Home signals into one system, so answers are grounded in your full context. Use Normal mode for quick answers, or Deep Research for answers backed by credible medical research.

tag: Nightly screening for signs of atrial fibrillation.
body: Your Ring captures heart rhythm data while you sleep. FibriCheck, a CE-marked and FDA-cleared heart rhythm technology, analyses those readings using a clinically validated algorithm to look for signs of AFib or atrial flutter. A medical-grade report is ready each morning and saved to your history over time.

tag: Ovulation confirmed from your own biometrics.
body: Most cycle trackers predict ovulation from past cycles. Cycle & Ovulation Pro uses OvuSense technology and your own biometrics to confirm whether ovulation actually happened, with over 90% accuracy. It also detects anovulatory cycles and Cycle Flags, helping you understand patterns across irregular, long, short and changing cycles.

tag: Snoring, coughing and breathing disruptions, tracked every night.
body: Respiratory Health combines Sleep Cycle’s sound analysis with your Ring’s HRV, heart rate, movement and sleep data. See when snoring, coughing and breathing disruptions happened, how your body responded and how patterns change over time. Powered by Sleep Cycle, with insights from 3 billion+ analysed sleep sessions.

tag: Your medical records alongside your ring data for informed health choices.
body: View your lab results, diagnoses and prescriptions alongside your sleep, temperature, HRV and recovery scores. Discover the checks your medicines call for. Understand each finding in plain language. Walk into your next appointment prepared, with the evidence behind every question.

tag: Training matched to how your body recovered.
body: Your Ring uses your recovery to match you with the right Les Mills workout for the day. Choose from 23 programs and 1,000+ classes, with heart-rate zones, calories and session stats automatically logged after every workout.

tag: See how your body responds to every drive.
body: UltraSync links every drive with your Ring data. See your readiness before you set off, how your heart rate and HRV respond along the route, and which journeys place the most strain on your body.

tag: Understand the patterns around your headaches.
body: See the 72 hours of Ring data around each logged headache and uncover patterns across HRV, sleep, recovery and cycle. Built with Click Therapeutics, Migraine Insights pairs those insights with an 8-week programme of short lessons and practical skills.

tag: Protection for your Ring, from damage to loss and theft.
body: UltrahumanX is designed for everything that can happen after you start wearing your Ring. From changes in fit to unexpected damage or loss, it gives you added protection and flexibility when you need it.
